[Council File 26-1141; CD 15]
Motion (McOsker – Blumenfield) relative to requesting the City Attorney, in coordination with the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD), Department of City Planning (DCP), and Department of Building and Safety (DBS), to obtain and provide to Council District 15: 1) the feasibility study for the JCT Jones Chemicals, Inc. Harbor Gateway facility, and provide an assessment of whether and to what extent the study may be publicly disclosed; and 2) any proposed consent order concerning the JCI Harbor Gateway facility, prior to adoption, and provide an assessment of whether and to what extent the consent order may be publicly disclosed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion requesting information about JCI Harbor Gateway facility.

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee approved item(s) (Sep 8, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 18, 2026); Council action final
